text:
maya: Quick ask — putting together a short customer-facing liftoff checklist for onboarding accounts that expect bursty traffic. Needs to cover caching, batching, streaming, telemetry, and a simple renewal-risk signal. Can we draft a concise 1‑page runbook?

ethan: +1. Keep it prescriptive and copy-paste friendly (snippets & exact checks).

priya: I'll take it. Draft bullets off the top: verify auth & model pin, enable short cache for stable prompts, set conservative batching with observed-latency guard, prefer streaming for UX flows but provide polling fallback, and telemetry + alert thresholds.

lena: Add a tiny cache header example customers can set when they control the CDN: 
```http
Cache-Control: max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=60
X-Redwood-Shared-Cache: tenant-id-123
```

ethan: SDK batching example to include in the one-pager: 
```py
# suggested client config
client.generate(..., batch_policy={"max_batch_tokens":1024, "latency_slo_ms":150})
```

priya: Renewal-risk signals to watch (customer-facing wording): sudden QPS drop, rising error rate (4xx/5xx), sustained latency increase, and a drop in unique intents/queries. Score them: 0=healthy, 1=watch, 2=engage, 3=escalate. Then map actions to score.

maya: Can we make the CS rep checklist for the first 48 hours super actionable? Short steps.

priya: 48h quick playbook for CS rep: 
- 0–2h: Confirm API keys, model pins, run 3 smoke prompts (happy-path, long-context, edge-case).
- 2–12h: Turn on short cache (30s) for repeat queries, start hourly telemetry collection, watch for error spikes.
- 12–24h: Tune batching thresholds if median latency > target, enable streaming on interactive routes and validate partial output UX.
- 24–48h: Compute renewal risk score, capture qualititative feedback, schedule follow-up if score >=2.

lena: Telemetry snippet for console/SQL to include: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) AS error_count, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_latency
FROM requests
WHERE tenant_id='T-123' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

ops-bot: Reminder: link the runbook to central CS playbooks: https://confluence.internal/cs/liftoff (auto-note).

ethan: Add rollback play actions: pin model to last-known-good version, reduce batch size, and if streaming causes instability, temporarily switch to non-streaming polling.

maya: Perfect. Priya — can you compress this into <=300 words and post the draft here by EOD? I'll share with field ops tomorrow morning.

priya: On it — will post a neat one-pager draft here before 6pm. :memo: 

lena: small add: include how to request burst/dedicated capacity for demo-day customers and who to contact (capacity@redwood).

maya: Good call. Tagging ops-team for capacity planning if we see >10x baseline in the first 24h.

ethan: :thumbsup:
